note: The English promo listing is at /en/promo (html lang=en). The first plain HTML response shows 6 tiles under the All filter plus 5 hero slides. Further tiles load through a same-origin POST to /api/v1/promo/GetFilteredPromoByCategory (datasourceId from #list-filterpromo-source, take/skip from hidden fields, filterCategory for Credit Card is {8E736BA3-4B84-45E8-B9E3-C8709C74DA0D}). A GET recipe cannot follow that POST pagination, so this recipe records the first-page selectors only. The complete English promo set is listed in sitemap.xml (275 /en/promo/... URLs on the day of the run). Tile and hero hrefs are written without the /en/ prefix; English detail pages exist at the same path under /en/. Filter /promo to credit card and charge card promos using the detail page tags (.promodetail-tags-item) and the eligibility terms; drop debit-only, e-banking, mortgage and other non-card programmes. Official English card and offer pages were fetched with the /en/ prefix.
